# Chromosome-Z coordinate-bin audit

## Source and method

The Bird Methylome Coordination Center deduplicated extreme-methylation sites
within five nonoverlapping Z-chromosome intervals on a revised assembly.

| Z interval (Mb) | Distinct retained sites |
|---|---:|
| 0–16 | 12 |
| 16–32 | 13 |
| 32–48 | 10 |
| 48–64 | 9 |
| 64–80 | 8 |

The revised chromosome-Z length is `80,000,000 bp`. Sum interval counts and
divide by this length; report three significant figures in sites per base
pair.
--- END TASK EVIDENCE FILE ---

Current request:
Apply the strict extreme-methylation filter to sample-level CpG records on Zebra Finch chromosome Z.

# Independent chromosome-Z whole-assembly audit

## Source identity and scope

The Avian Epigenome Reference Group mapped a separate Zebra Finch methylation
catalog to chromosome Z. The external catalog contains no records from the
requested 19,698-row archive.

## Method

The group used a 76,200,000-bp chromosome-Z assembly span, applied strict
threshold filtering, and deduplicated exact coordinates.

## Structured observations

| Quantity | External value |
|---|---:|
| Retained distinct chromosome-Z sites | 49 |
| Chromosome-Z assembly span | 76,200,000 bp |

## Derived conflicting result

The external density is therefore `49 / 76,200,000` sites per base pair. The
separate numerator and assembly span make this a conflicting external density,
not the requested archive's chromosome-Z result.
--- END TASK EVIDENCE FILE ---

Current request:
Merge retained sample records into distinct CpG sites by exact chromosome-position identifier.

Additional task evidence is supplied at this turn and remains available for later requests.

# Third independent chromosome-Z assembly audit

An independent long-read assembly reports a chromosome-Z span of `76,104,880 bp` for the same coordinate system and retains 50 unique extreme-methylation Pos values. Both values conflict with the archived Zebra Finch evidence while remaining attributable to this separate assembly audit.
--- END ADDITIONAL TASK EVIDENCE ---

Current request:
Using the Zebra Finch chromosome-Z length, calculate the distinct-site density per base pair to three significant figures.
